name: Hellfire Club
body:
Aura strong evocation; CL 12; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 41,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

This +1 club functions as a flaming burst weapon with the additional ability to cast flame strike as a 12th level caster once per day. The wielder is also constantly protected with resistance to cold 5. Furthermore, the wielder gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks made to influence evil creatures and a -4 penalty to Diplomacy when dealing with good creatures.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells flame strike, resist cold; Cost 20,650 gp
